Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    IsBlank(EmailInput_1.Text) Or
    IsBlank(UsernameInput_1.Text) Or
    IsBlank(PasswordInput_1.Text) Or
    IsBlank(ConfirmPasswordInput_1.Text) Or
    IsBlank(ContactInput_1.Text),
    Notify("Please fill in all fields", NotificationType.Error),

    !IsMatch(EmailInput_1.Text, Match.Email),
    Notify("Please enter a valid email address", NotificationType.Error),

    PasswordInput_1.Text <> ConfirmPasswordInput_1.Text,
    Notify("Passwords do not match", NotificationType.Error),

    !IsBlank(LookUp(BeachDetails, Email = EmailInput_1.Text)),
    Notify("An account with this email already exists", NotificationType.Error),

    Patch(
        BeachDetails,
        Defaults(BeachDetails),
        {
            Title: UsernameInput_1.Text,
            Email: EmailInput_1.Text,
            Username: UsernameInput_1.Text,
            Password: PasswordInput_1.Text,
            'Re - Enter Password': ConfirmPasswordInput_1.Text,
            'Contact Number': ContactInput_1.Text,
            Opens: "",
            Closes: ""
        }
    );
    Notify("Beach facility account created!", NotificationType.Success);
    Navigate('Beach Page 1')
)
